productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Beautiful Book but there are some things to work on….
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This book is pretty nice. However, I would prefer the seller to work on a few things. I don’t really care for the black pages in the book. I understand they are there to prevent bleeding but , I really hate the fact that they are black. They are a deep black, causes me to feel depressed when searching for my preferred animal to color. Please make the pages whites. Also why is the book this 8.5 size? I would prefer the taller size. I also prefer spiral bound but I notice the spiral bound is too expensive compared to the regular paperbacks I don’t like that. It’s just animals on pages with nothing in the background. I would like to see more mandala patterns in the background or floral patterns. Another thing that is too dark is the animals theirselves. There is too much darkness and shadings. That is an extreme pet peeve, especially when it comes to coloring books. I neeed to color! I don’t want to see color already in my images.The good things are the paper is thick which is nice for gel pens, alcohol markers, and colored pencils but I highly prefer using gel pens over alcohol markers and colored pencils. The book cover is beautiful. The price of the paperback is good. The diversity of animals is ok. I would have preferred more animal pages in the book. The book is a bit too short for my liking. Overall I would give this book 3 stars.
